The Morning
Kettle Moraine Residential is an invented company and every figure is synthetic, seeded once.

The Morning

Every community and every unit on one map. Pick a number and the map shows the units behind it; zoom into a community and every unit is a door. The ranked list, with the reason attached, is below.

Communities with nothing above threshold sit at the bottom, and there are supposed to be a lot of them. Exposure counts units on notice and vacant, less pre-leased, over the next sixty days. Delinquency is the ledger balance as a share of this month's billed rent.

The Market

Where each community is priced against its own six comps, and who moved since yesterday. Comp fields follow ApartmentIQ's names so a real export can replace this table.

The Calendar

The next 120 days across the portfolio: lease expirations, move-outs, move-ins and make-ready due dates, one row per community. Click a cell for the list.

Explore

Pick a number, drag across the weeks, click a floor plan, a market or a community. Each chart filters the others, and the sentence above them is the view's name.

Reports

Six standard reports, each one Explore with its settings applied, and the views you saved. Open one, schedule it, or take it away as a PDF, a deck or the rows.
